name: 点电荷电场强度计算器

map.由点电荷与距离，按 E = k·q/r²（k=8.988×10⁹）计算真空中该点: Compute the electric field strength at a distance from a point charge with E = k·q/r² (k = 8.988×10⁹) in vacuum.
map.电场方向沿径向：正电荷向外、负电荷向内。输入单位为微库仑(µC)。: Field direction is radial: outward from positive charge, inward to negative. Input unit is microcoulomb (µC).
map.📚 深度解析：电场强度 E: 📚 Deep Dive: Electric Field Strength E
map.点电荷电场。: Electric field of a point charge.
map.估算点电荷周围不同距离处的电场强度。: Estimate electric field strength at various distances around a point charge.
map.正电荷向外、负电荷向内。: Outward from positive, inward to negative.
map.多个电荷怎么办？: What if there are multiple charges?
map.按叠加原理做矢量相加。: Apply the superposition principle and add them as vectors.
